tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background, the ground of every view. Light: porcelain; dark: midnight navy.

tokens.name: page-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands and quiet wells (FAQ, office list). Never for cards.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the sticky header once scrolled, menus. Pair with a `line` border in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the mobile menu sheet, toasts — anything above `raised`.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside text inputs, selects and textareas.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The navy band: hero panels, CtaBand, credential strip. Always dark in both themes; text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Footer ground, the darkest navy. Text on it is `on-brand` / `on-brand-muted`.

tokens.name: portrait
tokens.usage: Panel behind the cut-out portrait. Use with `portrait-glow` as a radial light so the navy suit separates in dark mode.

tokens.name: portrait-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the radial light behind the portrait head and shoulders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on `page`, `page-subtle`, `raised`, `overlay`, `field`. 16.0:1 or better in light, 13.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — leads, card summaries, form hints — on `page`, `page-subtle`, `raised`. 7.3:1 light / 8.4:1 dark minimum.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta only: dates, read times, captions, placeholders, on `page`, `page-subtle`, `raised`, `overlay`. 5.0:1 light / 5.3:1 dark minimum.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on `brand` and `brand-deep` (12.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, footer links and legal fine print on `brand` and `brand-deep` (7.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action per view (Button primary): the brand vermilion, the same in both themes. The white `on-accent` label measures 3.96:1 on it, under the 4.5:1 AA target for button-size text and above the 3:1 target for large text and control boundaries; see the contrast note in Color.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Darker in both themes so the white label gains contrast (5.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button active/pressed (white label 7.9:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Vermilion as text: inline links, eyebrows, active nav underline, quote marks, stars. A step darker than `accent` in light, a lighter tint in dark. On `page`, `page-subtle`, `raised`, `overlay`, `accent-soft` — 5.4:1 light / 5.6:1 dark minimum. Never for paragraphs.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `accent-ink` text: the "Featured" badge, selected filter chip.

tokens.name: accent-on-brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill when it sits on a `brand` band. Vermilion holds on navy, so it is the same `vermilion-500` as `accent`: 4.1:1 against light-theme `brand`, 3.5:1 against dark-theme `brand`. White label 3.96:1, as on `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `accent`, `accent-hover`, `accent-pressed`, `accent-on-brand`.

tokens.name: pip
tokens.usage: The square full stop in the wordmark and the list bullet, on `page`, `page-subtle`, `raised`, `overlay`. Graphic only, never text: 3.7:1 light / 3.9:1 dark minimum.

tokens.name: pip-on-brand
tokens.usage: The pip on `brand` and `brand-deep` (reverse logos, footer link underlines). The same `vermilion-500` as `pip`, because vermilion keeps 3:1 on navy: 4.1:1 on light-theme `brand`, 3.5:1 on dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, table rules. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons: 3.6:1 on `field`/`page` light, 3.1:1 on `field`/`raised` dark (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: line-brand
tokens.usage: Hairlines on `brand` and `brand-deep` (footer column rules, CtaBand divider).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every light/dark surface. Same value as `ink`, 13.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: focus-on-brand
tokens.usage: Focus ring on `brand`, `brand-deep` and `accent` fills.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background (::selection). Text stays `ink`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the mobile menu and dialogs.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (form sent) on `page`, `raised`, `success-soft`. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (statute of limitations reminders) on `page`, `raised`, `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: field messages, invalid borders, error alerts, on `page`, `field`, `raised`, `danger-soft` (5.9:1 or better). Crimson, deliberately cooler and bluer than the vermilion accent so an error never reads as a brand color; always with an icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices (office hours, Spanish available) on `page`, `raised`, `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info alerts.
